admitted_yukawa_algebra: The associative algebra generated by I, A0, D0, and phi0 phi0^dagger in the WP443 vacuum.
classification: The WP443 full-Higgsing vacuum is outside the measured physical16 flavor domain for every Yukawa built from its admitted vacuum algebra.
instrument_gate: Flavor experiments establish the nonzero CKM entries, but their meson bounds cannot calibrate WP445 until a viable source vacuum supplies the mass-basis map.
smallest_exact_falsifier: Any admitted polynomial in the frozen vacuum generators with a nonzero 2-to-3 or 3-to-2 matrix entry.
remaining_gate: Enlarge the source vacuum algebra independently so it acts irreducibly on C^3, then repeat global stability and current matching.
